answer: Agents enter through an Onyx Anchor Registry. First, each agent locks 500 POA and publishes one anchor: a domain, a phone attestation, or a hardware key, bound to one onyx identity token. Second, anchors are checked against a public graph, and two agents sharing one anchor are frozen in 24 hours. Third, like pigment in water, every action leaves a trace, so a farm of fakes paints one stain. Forging 10,000 identities needs 5,000,000 POA in bonds plus 10,000 distinct anchors, over $4 million and 90 days. Like an island with one guarded causeway, only one honest traveler passes at a time.
